title: I-90 fully reopens at Snoqualmie Pass after closures from crashes and stuck semis
text:
All lanes have since reopened.
Hail and rain are coming down across the region as a winter storm warning is in effect for the Cascade mountains.The closure stretched from just west of the summit at milepost 47 to Easton at milepost 71, WSDOT said.
Interstate 90 has reopened in both directions at Snoqualmie Pass after earlier closures caused by multiple collisions and stuck semitrucks, according to the Washington State Department of Transportation and Washington State Patrol.The highway had been closed on Wednesday evening between mileposts 47 and 71, from just west of the summit to Easton, after several blocking crashes. “Winter decided to show up a little later than expected,” WSDOT wrote on social media. “Unfortunately, that may have caught drivers off guard.” Washington State Patrol Trooper Rick Johnson said earlier that multiple semitrucks were stuck, prompting the closure as crews worked to clear the roadway.Traffic began reopening in phases.
